name: Ultimate Coherence / Non-Destructive Expansion Pipeline
purpose: Continuously expand and refine the project from internal and external references without allowing external references to overwrite internal invariants.

epistemic_model.internal_reference_frame: The canonical project state, policies, verified invariants, provenance, accepted checkpoints and current timeline.
epistemic_model.external_reference_frame: Any source observed from outside the canonical state, represented internally as an untrusted reference object.
epistemic_model.boundary_rule: An external reference becomes an internal object only after ingestion and provenance binding; it never becomes an internal authority merely by ingestion.
epistemic_model.perspective_rule: All comparisons are evaluated from the current canonical internal state while preserving the source perspective of the reference.

coherence_closure.definition: A candidate is coherent only when its required dependencies, provenance, policy, temporal state, resources and verification obligations are all satisfied.
coherence_closure.conflict_policy: Preserve both states, identify the conflict, quarantine the candidate, and require resolution; never erase the canonical state.
coherence_closure.refinement_rule: A refinement may replace an implementation only through a verified transition that preserves all protected invariants.

internalization.rule: Promotion is explicit and reversible; reference presence never implies execution permission.

self_expansion.frontier_definition: The set of unresolved dependencies, missing capabilities, unverified hypotheses and useful references.
self_expansion.selection_rule: Select frontier work by evidence, coherence impact, expected value, resource cost and risk, subject to policy.
self_expansion.recursion_rule: If a frontier item is too complex for one iteration, causally decompose it until each leaf is independently verifiable.
self_expansion.memory_rule: Persist checkpoints and references; never require full history replay.
self_expansion.timewarp_rule: Every mutation capable of changing canonical state must be branchable and reversible.
